== Summary ==
[[Anthony Vittone]], senior vice president of Decipher's Fan Club Studio, at the world premiere of ''The Fellowship of the Ring'' in London (2001). Head-and-shoulders crop of [[:File:Vittone, Holland and Fan Club winners at The Fellowship of the Ring premiere 2001.jpg]], where the caption names him first, left to right. Photo: Decipher.

== Source ==
* Tomi M. Inkinen, "Journey of a Lifetime: The World Premiere of ''The Lord of the Rings''", ''The Lord of the Rings Fan Club Official Movie Magazine'' 2 (April/May 2002), Decipher, p. 11. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/lotr-fan-club-official-movie-magazine-issue-02-gandalf-300-dpi/page/n10/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n10).
* Crop: x 860–1074, y 210–495 of the 2325×3135 leaf, head centred.
